notes.subject: הלכתי
notes.rationale: Ketiv 'yu wokabaut i go' (halakht) vs qere 'mi wokabaut' (halakhti); olgeta olsem ol i go long 'yu' — ketiv i strongpela long context

notes.subject: תמרורים
notes.rationale: 'pail ston / mak bilong soim rot' — tok i raritable; KJV 'heaps', JPS 'guide-posts'

notes.subject: kam bek, betul bilong Yisrael
notes.rationale: Yahwe i singautim Yisrael long kam bek — tupela taem 'שובי'

notes.subject: שובי ... שבי
notes.rationale: Olsem pasin bilong חדשה long v22: 'shuvi ... shuvi' — wanpela tok i kamap tupela taem, i no save lus long tanim tok

translation: Stapim ol mak bilong rot long ples bilong yu yet, putim ol pail ston bilong soim rot; putim bel bilong yu long rot bilong go — dispela rot yu wokabaut i go tru olsem. Kam bek, betul bilong Yisrael, kam bek long ol dispela siti bilong yu.

tokens.gloss: ol pail ston bilong soim rot
